column1: # MSUF globals the addons read through MSUF.Optional (tools/tests/optional_globals_smoke.lua).
# Every other cross-file MSUF global is a hard dependency read through MSUF.Require: a missing
# provider must fail loudly. A name belongs here only when its absence is a designed state:
#   lod-options      provided by the load-on-demand MidnightSimpleUnitFrames_Options addon
#   module-toggle    exported only while its module is enabled
#   load-order       reachable while the core is still loading, before the provider's file
# Evidence is the provider file that defines the name. Rows only shrink or follow new Optional reads.
